title: Replace brake chamber
description: Removed and replaced defective brake chamber. Inspected slack adjuster and pushrod travel, adjusted brakes to specification, and tested for air leaks. Verified proper brake application and release.

title: Replace brake shoes and linings
description: Replaced worn brake shoes and linings on axle. Cleaned and inspected drums, replaced hardware kit, lubricated cam shaft and S-cam bushings, and adjusted brakes to proper clearance. Road tested for correct operation.

title: Replace brake drum
description: Removed and replaced cracked/worn brake drum. Inspected bearings and seals, repacked wheel bearings, installed new seal, and adjusted brakes. Verified torque on wheel fasteners to manufacturer specification.

title: Replace automatic slack adjuster
description: Replaced failed automatic slack adjuster. Greased and verified free movement, set proper installation angle, and adjusted pushrod stroke to specification. Tested brake application for correct self-adjustment.

title: Replace ABS wheel speed sensor
description: Diagnosed ABS fault and replaced defective wheel speed sensor and clip. Cleaned sensor bore, applied anti-seize, cleared fault codes, and confirmed ABS lamp operation and signal output.

title: Replace leaking wheel seal
description: Replaced leaking hub wheel seal contaminating brake linings. Cleaned hub and spindle, repacked bearings with grease, installed new seal, and adjusted brakes. Verified no further leakage.

title: Replace air spring (air bag)
description: Removed and replaced ruptured air spring. Inspected mounting plate and piston for damage, checked height control valve operation, and verified correct ride height. Tested system for leaks at operating pressure.

title: Replace shock absorber
description: Replaced worn/leaking shock absorber. Inspected mounting bushings and brackets, torqued fasteners to specification, and verified proper damping. Checked surrounding suspension components for wear.

title: Replace suspension bushings
description: Replaced worn equalizer/spring eye bushings. Removed suspension components, pressed in new bushings, reassembled, and torqued all fasteners to specification. Verified proper alignment and free movement.

title: Replace ride height control valve
description: Replaced malfunctioning height control valve. Adjusted linkage, set ride height to specification, and verified proper inflation and exhaust of air springs. Confirmed level ride and no leaks.

title: Replace broken leaf spring
description: Removed and replaced broken leaf spring assembly. Inspected hangers, U-bolts, and saddle for damage, installed new U-bolts, and torqued to specification. Verified correct axle alignment.

title: Repair air line leak
description: Diagnosed and repaired air leak in trailer air system. Replaced damaged air line/fitting, pressure tested system, and verified no leakage at rated pressure. Confirmed proper brake response.

title: Replace gladhand and seals
description: Replaced damaged gladhand coupler and seal on service/emergency line. Inspected mounting and lines, verified secure connection, and pressure tested for leaks. Confirmed proper coupling with tractor.

title: Replace air tank drain valve
description: Replaced corroded/leaking air tank drain valve. Drained and inspected tank for contamination, installed new valve with sealant, and pressure tested for leaks.

title: Replace brake relay valve
description: Replaced faulty relay valve causing slow brake response. Inspected supply and delivery lines, installed new valve, and tested for proper crack pressure and timing. Verified no leaks.

title: Replace tail/stop/turn light
description: Replaced inoperative tail/stop/turn lamp assembly. Inspected and cleaned connector, verified ground, and tested all functions for proper operation. Sealed connection against moisture.

title: Repair trailer wiring harness
description: Diagnosed and repaired damaged trailer wiring harness. Located fault, repaired/replaced affected wiring with sealed connections, secured harness, and tested all lighting circuits for proper operation.

title: Replace 7-way connector (nosebox)
description: Replaced corroded/damaged 7-way trailer connector. Cleaned and repaired wiring terminals, applied dielectric grease, and tested all circuits for continuity and proper function.

title: Replace clearance/marker lights
description: Replaced burned-out clearance/marker lamps. Inspected grommets and seals, verified ground connections, and tested for proper illumination. Sealed to prevent moisture intrusion.

title: Replace license plate light
description: Replaced inoperative license plate lamp. Cleaned connection, verified ground, and confirmed proper illumination of plate.

title: Mount and dismount tire
description: Dismounted worn tire and mounted new/replacement tire on rim. Inspected rim for damage, installed new valve stem, inflated to specification, and torqued wheel fasteners to manufacturer specification.

title: Repair flat tire
description: Located puncture and repaired tire using approved plug/patch method. Inspected casing for damage, reinflated to specification, and verified no leaks. Remounted and torqued wheel fasteners.

title: Replace damaged wheel/rim
description: Replaced bent/cracked wheel rim. Transferred or installed tire, inflated to specification, and torqued wheel fasteners to manufacturer specification in proper sequence.

title: Replace wheel studs
description: Replaced broken/stripped wheel studs. Inspected hub and mounting surface, installed new studs and nuts, and torqued to specification. Verified proper wheel seating.

title: Rotate tires
description: Rotated trailer tires to promote even wear. Inspected tread depth and condition, set inflation to specification, and torqued all wheel fasteners.

title: Replace door hinge
description: Replaced broken/worn rear door hinge. Aligned door for proper seal and operation, installed new hardware, and verified smooth swing and secure latching.

title: Repair roll-up door
description: Repaired roll-up (overhead) door operation. Replaced damaged panels/rollers, adjusted spring tension and cables, lubricated track, and verified smooth raising and lowering.

title: Replace door seal/gasket
description: Replaced worn/damaged door seal to restore weather and air tightness. Cleaned mounting surface, installed new gasket, and verified proper compression and closure.

title: Replace door lock/latch hardware
description: Replaced damaged cam lock/latch and keepers. Adjusted for secure closure, lubricated moving parts, and verified positive locking and release.

title: Replace floor boards
description: Removed damaged/rotted floor boards and installed replacement boards. Inspected cross members for corrosion, secured new boards with proper fasteners, and verified level, solid floor surface.

title: Repair/replace floor cross member
description: Repaired or replaced corroded/cracked floor cross member. Removed affected section, welded/installed new member, and verified structural integrity and proper floor support.

title: Reseal/coat floor
description: Cleaned and resealed floor to protect against moisture and wear. Applied approved coating, verified full coverage, and allowed proper cure time.

title: Service reefer unit
description: Performed scheduled service on refrigeration unit. Replaced filters, checked belts, inspected refrigerant charge, verified defrost operation, and confirmed unit holds set point temperature.

title: Recover, evacuate and recharge refrigerant
description: Recovered refrigerant, evacuated system, and recharged to specification. Leak tested system, verified proper operating pressures, and confirmed unit reaches and holds set point.

title: Replace reefer drive belt
description: Replaced worn/broken drive belt on refrigeration unit. Inspected pulleys and tensioner, set correct tension, and verified proper unit operation.

title: Replace reefer fuel filter
description: Replaced fuel filter on refrigeration unit diesel engine. Primed fuel system, bled air, and verified proper engine start and operation.

title: Weld repair frame crack
description: Repaired cracked frame/rail by grinding out crack and welding to restore integrity. Inspected surrounding area, reinforced as needed, and verified sound, structurally safe repair.

title: Replace frame cross member
description: Removed damaged/corroded frame cross member and installed replacement. Welded/bolted to specification, verified alignment, and confirmed structural integrity.

title: Repair/replace rub rail
description: Replaced damaged rub rail and mounting hardware. Straightened or replaced affected section, secured to frame, and verified proper protection of side wall.

title: Replace mud flaps and hangers
description: Replaced worn/missing mud flaps and damaged hangers/brackets. Secured to frame, verified proper height and coverage, and confirmed compliance.

title: Replace landing gear leg
description: Removed and replaced damaged/bent landing gear leg. Aligned and matched to companion leg, lubricated gearing, and verified smooth, even raising and lowering through full travel.

title: Repair landing gear crank/gearbox
description: Repaired landing gear crank handle and gearbox. Replaced worn gears/handle, lubricated mechanism, and verified smooth operation in high and low range.

title: Replace landing gear foot/shoe
description: Replaced damaged landing gear foot pad/shoe. Inspected leg for damage, installed new foot, and verified stable support and proper retraction.

title: Inspect/measure kingpin
description: Inspected and measured kingpin for wear using gauge. Checked upper coupler plate for cracks and proper lubrication, and confirmed kingpin within wear specification for safe coupling.

title: Replace kingpin
description: Removed worn/damaged kingpin and installed replacement. Inspected upper coupler assembly, welded/secured per specification, and verified proper dimensions and safe coupling.

title: Lubricate upper coupler/fifth wheel plate
description: Cleaned and lubricated upper coupler plate to ensure proper fifth wheel engagement. Inspected for cracks and wear, and applied approved grease.

title: Annual DOT/FMCSA inspection
description: Performed annual federal (DOT/FMCSA) inspection. Checked brakes, lights, tires, suspension, frame, coupling, and air system. Documented findings and affixed inspection sticker.

title: Preventive maintenance (PM) service
description: Performed preventive maintenance service. Lubricated all grease points, inspected brakes, tires, lights, and air system, checked fluid levels, and documented condition and recommendations.

title: Wash and clean trailer
description: Pressure washed and cleaned trailer exterior/interior as requested. Removed buildup and debris and inspected for visible damage during cleaning.

title: Road service call
description: Responded to road service call. Diagnosed reported issue on site, performed necessary repair to return unit to service, and verified safe operation. Includes travel/service time.
